summary: @servicetitan/mpa-components preinstall smuggles Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (identifiers like `_0x488df8`), platform-detects, downloads the Bun runtime binary (v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it to run the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line obfuscator.io-style bundle (string-array rotation via `WV8StW` cycling the `n7gIxM` array, hex-named identifiers, no readable strings, header `// @bun @bun-cjs`); it is never referenced by `dist/index.js` and only executes through this preinstall→Bun path. A React component library has no functional need to acquire a second language runtime at install time, and the payload is deliberately shaped to evade Node-based scanners by running under Bun. The behavior fires automatically on `npm install` and results in arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine under the developer or CI account.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
